🎬 F1: The Movie (2025)

F1: The Movie follows Sonny Hayes, a former Formula One racing prodigy whose promising career was cut short by a devastating accident decades earlier. Now an experienced racer competing in smaller motorsport events, Sonny receives an unexpected opportunity when his former teammate Ruben Cervantes asks him to return to Formula One and help save APXGP, a struggling racing team facing the possibility of collapse. Reluctantly stepping back into the world’s most competitive racing championship, Sonny discovers that the sport has changed dramatically since his previous experience. Alongside Joshua Pearce, a talented but ambitious young driver determined to establish himself as a future superstar, Sonny must navigate intense rivalries, demanding training sessions, complicated team dynamics, and the enormous pressure of competing against the world’s fastest drivers. Their contrasting personalities and approaches to racing initially create tension, but both gradually learn valuable lessons about teamwork, trust, and the sacrifices required to succeed. Meanwhile, the team works tirelessly to improve its performance while facing technical setbacks, dangerous races, and growing pressure from sponsors and management. As Sonny confronts painful memories from his past, he must decide whether he still has what it takes to compete at the highest level. Combining breathtaking racing sequences, emotional storytelling, intense competition, and spectacular Formula One action, F1: The Movie explores redemption, ambition, mentorship, resilience, teamwork, and the determination to chase greatness despite overwhelming odds.

🎭 Genre: Sports • Action • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 36m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Joseph Kosinski

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV. Availability varies by region.
